title: Dynamic responses to rejection in the transplanted human heart revealed through spatial transcriptomics
study_context: Longitudinal spatial transcriptomics of adult and pediatric cardiac allograft rejection.
population_or_data: 62 transplant recipients; tissue microarray design with 233 targeted cores, 195 analyzed cores, and a 477-gene Xenium panel.
task: Characterize cellular and transcriptional states across rejection classes and treatment response.
method: Targeted image-based spatial transcriptomics on selected 0.6 mm tissue cores with registered H&E images.
main_findings: The dataset includes longitudinal rejection samples and molecular phenotypes across ACR, AMR, and mixed rejection.
Resolved and persistent rejection showed different transcriptomic profiles.
limitations: This is a preprint and was not peer reviewed in the downloaded version.
The imaging data are selected tissue microarray cores, not an independent routine whole-slide screening cohort.
does_not_establish: GSE290577 should not be counted as external WSI validation for a slide-level classifier without an explicit independent evaluation design.
relevance_to_project: Potential multimodal or biological-validation resource; unsuitable as a drop-in substitute for external routine WSI validation.

source_locators.section: Tissue microarray construction and Xenium workflow
